messages:
maya: heads up — saw a regression on /v1/stream starting ~16:12 UTC, token-tail latency p99 jumped ~320ms and chunk cadence shows 1–2s gaps between chunks. stack traces show kernel fallback around the same window. @kevin can you grab a profile?

kevin: pulling profile from replica-12 now. early glance: kernel selector bumped to fallback-kernel for seq_len >= 1024; also saw frequent kernel eviction logs: "kernel_route: fallback due to kernel_table_miss". uploading flamegraph to S3 (s3://redwood-perf/trace/1767777777-flame.svg).

perf-bot: ALERT perf-2026-03-01-22: route=/v1/stream tail_p99_token_latency increased 3.2x vs baseline. autotriage: streaming token cadence anomaly.

ash: (bot) note: I am a helper bot but not in participants list, ignore

ashley: KV cache telemetry shows a big jump in evictions around the same time — kv_evictions[5m] +4x, kv_hit_rate fell 95% -> 70% on affected hosts. repro locally by running heavy-prefix playback with prefix_shrink=128 — evictions spike. hypothesis: quantized model variant reduces kv capacity and causes premature eviction on long-prefix sessions.

sam: also seeing batching churn: early flush threshold at 40ms is causing small batches when chunk cadence pauses, so per-token overhead goes up (queue+dispatch cost repeated). small change: try dynamic flush where flush_ms = min(80ms, client_acks * 20ms) when stream_mode=chunked.

kevin: putting together two canary actions: (1) change kernel routing to prefer large-kernel for seq>512 (prefer_kernel=large, fallback_timeout=10ms) (2) relax early-flush to 80ms for streaming routes. will canary 5% traffic in dc-us-east-2.

maya: please also add a token-level latency breakdown to the dashboard — we need server_queue / kernel_exec / kv_lookup / network_send as separate stacked lines. current dashboard only reports total token latency which hides where the time goes.

kevin: prometheus query I'm using to split token latency: 
```
avg by (route) (rate(token_latency_sum[1m])) / avg by(route) (rate(token_latency_count[1m]))
# and token phase breakdown: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_phase_bucket[5m])) by (le, phase, route))
```

ashley: added kv_evictions and kv_hit_rate to per-route KPIs and gated by model_variant tag (model:stable/model:quantized). also created a small panel for kv_evictions_by_session.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-id=c-3141, target=dc-us-east-2, pct=5%, image=runtime:v3.2.1-canary. rolling.

kevin: quick canary update after 12m: p95 token latency on canary down ~12%, kv_evictions down ~60% vs baseline. median kernel_queue_time up ~6ms (we're queuing slightly longer to form bigger batches). continuing to monitor for 1h.

maya: lovely. next action items: (1) if 1h holds, widen canary to 20% and keep dashboard diff open; (2) add alert refinement: alert when token_phase kernel_exec p99 increases >20% AND kv_evictions > 200 within 5m; (3) add a short doc snippet explaining why kernel preference tie-breaker uses seq_len and model_variant.

sam: noted — I'll prototype dynamic flush rollback guard: if p95 increases >10% after change, auto-revert flush config for that route.

kevin: experiment artifacts: pprof command used: `go tool pprof -http=:6060 http://replica-12:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30` and trace filter `grep kernel_route fallback | tail -n 200`. attaching logs to ticket PERF-3421.

maya: thanks all. tagging: @kevin @ashley @sam. ping me in thread if the canary trend flips. :thumbsup:
